Renders its children only while an entitlement holds; otherwise a slot of the host's choosing or the paywall. It renders nothing of its own while the entitlement is loading.

<ComponentStates component="EntitlementGate" />

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** `EntitlementGate(screen:content:locked:)` around a feature.

    **Styled part.** The `locked` slot.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.entitlementGate(_:)`: only the entitlement decides; a theme or style never unlocks.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** A host places `<EntitlementGate />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, given an `input`.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<EntitlementGate />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("EntitlementGate", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** `PolarisEntitlementGate(name) { … }` shows its content while the entitlement holds.

    **Styled part.** The same call with `tier`, `onUnlock` and a `locked` slot for your own locked card.

    **Headless.** `rememberPolarisEntitled(name)` returns the live answer; the boolean overload takes it.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.material3.Text
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisEntitlementGate

    @Composable
    fun ProFeature(unlock: () -> Unit) {
        PolarisEntitlementGate("pro", tier = "Pro", onUnlock = unlock) { Text("Pro feature") }
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the Android sample, the theme and the desktop windows.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Godot">
    <KitStatus kit="godot" />

    <GodotKitTab component="EntitlementGate" />

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
